verified_facts: 1m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England
2m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England
DTM represents terrain after surface objects are removed
composite DTM is derived from Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat-survey areas use newest best-resolution data
resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation before merging
2022 composite includes surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
metadata index catalogues identify which survey contributed at a location
1m and 2m composites share lineage and are not independent survey observations
resampling status must be retained before precision comparisons
DTM must not be substituted with DSM for bare-earth parcel elevation
coverage percentage does not guarantee parcel-level availability
quality_effect: Prevents composite/resampled products from being misclassified as independent high-precision parcel measurements and preserves survey lineage.
